shared_elements: human figures shown in profile/frontal schematic form
processional or repeated rows of figures
animals (bovine in A, none clearly in B)
repeated vertical strokes forming a rank of figures/crew
justification: Both surfaces depict human figures grouped into repeated rows, and in each case a rank of many identical upright strokes/bodies reads as a file of people (guards on a stair relief; crew strokes on boats), which is the only real correspondence. Otherwise A shows a naturalistically modelled architectural scene with columns, a bull attacked by a lion, and detailed costumed processions, whereas B shows radically schematic stick figures and crescent-hulled boats scattered with dot rows across an open field, with no architecture, no animals and no shared conventions of rendering.
